# Atmospheric Emergencies An atmospheric emergency is any disruption of the station's safe atmosphere.
The most common types of atmospheric emergencies are: - [textlink="Fires" link="Fires"] - [textlink="Depressurization" link="Spacing"] - [textlink="Pressure differences" link="DeltaPressure"]
Atmospheric technicians must assess these situations quickly, eliminate the cause, and return the area to a safe state.
This usually means isolating the area, stopping the leak or fire, and then restoring its pressure, temperature, and gas composition.
